description: Returns a number from 1 to 7 identifying the day of the week of the specified date.

params.description: A number that represents a date, or a result of other formulas or functions.
params.name: arg1

params.description: A number that determines the type of return value: **1** - returns a number from 1 (Sunday) to 7 (Saturday);**2** - returns a number from 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday); **3** - returns a number from 0 (Monday) to 6 (Sunday).
params.name: arg2

signature: WEEKDAY(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
